title: The Chatsworth Topped Off as Cladding Advances in Lawrence Park
summary: The Chatsworth has topped off at four storeys, with enclosure and exterior cladding progressing at the southeast corner of Chatsworth Drive and Duplex Avenue in Toronto’s Lawrence Park neighbourhood. Designed by Kirshenblatt Urban Architecture for Times Group Corporation, the condominium is taking on its finished character more than three years after UrbanToronto highlighted the start of construction in August, 2023.
